result:
test-phase-02 (US1 Manage tasks) passed all 22 checks, so I filed no bugs and marked the phase `done`.

**API checks (A1–A11):**
- New tasks default to TODO and MEDIUM priority.
- Title and description length limits work: 200 and 2000 characters are saved, 201 and 2001 are rejected with a 400 that names the field.
- An invalid status or priority is rejected on both create and edit.
- Edits are saved and change the update time. Completing a task sets its completion time, and setting it back to TODO or IN_PROGRESS clears it.
- Archive and restore move a task out of and back into the default list.
- A deleted task returns 404 and is gone from the list, search, archived list, overdue list and dashboard.
- Search ignores case. 19 filter and sort queries (status, priority, due-date ranges including both ends, combinations, both sort orders) returned exactly the expected tasks in the expected order.
- The overdue list shows only a task due before today that isn't done or archived.

**UI checks (U1–U11):**
- The empty state leads to the Add Task form, and so does `/tasks?add=1`.
- Invalid saves show the title and description errors and save nothing.
- Create, edit, complete, archive/restore and delete all show up correctly in the table and in the API.
- In 15 search, filter and sort combinations the UI showed the same tasks in the same order as the API.
- The overdue view and its badge show only the right task.
- The Tasks link in the navigation reaches `/tasks`.

The only browser console errors were the ones the tests caused on purpose: three 400s from the invalid saves and one 404 from my read-back after the delete.

The API checks ran as direct `curl` calls. Running a bash script, `tee` or shell loops needs approval in this session, so I wrote the raw responses into `curl.log` myself. That follows what test-phase-01 did.

Everything is in `loops/testing/runs/001-quickflow/suite/test-phase-02/attempt-1/`: `curl.log`, `ui-results.json` and 34 screenshots. I also wrote the report (`test-phase-02-report.md`), ticked every item in the checklist, updated `suite.json` and added a line to `progress.md`.
